title: Independent historical review of the 277-node Greece design and Aegean extension
status: Historical design review only; no runtime changes.
positive_findings: Starting constitutional/repression/officer burdens and the modest positive growth spirit fit the 1970 context.
Oil shock and civilian dislocation are conditional, not initial 1970 collapse.
KKE pluralist coalition and single-party state are visibly distinguished; the latter does not claim pluralist legitimacy.
The Cyprus contract correctly treats foreign acceptance and observed outcomes as separate from a completed Greek focus.
No ethnicity is used as an inherent starting penalty.

findings.finding: The route requires an already restored monarchy, yet its first focus negotiates the King's return and its final focus puts the settlement to voters. This makes the constitutional sequence circular and risks presenting a restoration as legitimate before a free vote.
findings.fix: Entry should require a monarchist political mandate or an unresolved constitutional restoration process, not a completed restoration. Bind later Crown powers/economic packages to an actual successful settlement. If the free vote rejects monarchy, record the republican outcome and lock restoration bonuses.

findings.location: nd route title 'Negotiate European Association'; centre 'Association on Equal Terms'
findings.finding: Greece already had the EEC Association Agreement signed in 1961. The dictatorship froze political development/cooperation; the agreement was not something first invented after 1974.
findings.fix: Use 'Reactivate the Association Framework' and 'Renegotiate Association Commitments' or equivalent. Keep association, full accession negotiations,1979 treaty and 1981 membership separate. Do not turn 'frozen' into automatic abolition of all trade obligations.

findings.finding: Calling the historical 1974 movement simply a social-democratic government can import today's moderate party identity into an initially radical socialist programme. MD's socialism slot is a gameplay mapping.
findings.fix: Say 'Andreas-led socialist government in the relevant MD party slot'. Mark parliamentary socialism and executive-centralizing choices as policy alternatives; do not claim that PAK held lawful government in 1970 or that PASOK existed before its actual formation.

findings.location: route leader gates, especially centre and pasok
findings.finding: Some prose gates identify a broad liberal/socialist current without explicitly requiring Mavros or Andreas control. A general outlook is insufficient to unlock a personal political programme.
findings.fix: Require both the actual party/current and named leader/faction control. A formal president/regent is a separate role from the prime minister or de facto junta chief. Papadopoulos after late 1973 liberalization is president while Markezinis is prime minister; Ioannidis is not Gizikis or Androutsopoulos.

findings.finding: Koligiannis-before-December 1972 and Florakis-afterwards are historical chronology, not grounds to force a succession if the player has deliberately retained a different party leadership.
findings.fix: Keep the historical default chronology but gate on actual party selection. If retained Koligiannis or earlier Florakis is supported, label that deviation explicitly. Do not merge KKE Interior into KKE.

findings.finding: Treaty agreements need counterpart acceptance, but another player should not acquire an absolute veto over Greece's domestic sovereign choices or lawful notice to end access. A Greek demand does not itself teleport foreign units away.
findings.fix: Distinguish a negotiated change requiring agreement from a unilateral notice/denial with legal, financial and security consequences. The foreign seat independently decides compliance/escalation; keep actual units and war decisions external.

findings.finding: Current prose contains joined numbers and words in multiple titles/notes. This harms reading and makes party labels look like implementation tokens.
findings.fix: Use 'January 1970', 'Constantine II', 'before 4 October 1974' and spaced source/date labels in the user-facing visualization. Do not alter actual IDs or script keys.

findings.location: cyprus_7 note: Ankara and Nicosia Must Respond
findings.finding: The event contract lists GRE/TUR/CYP/ENG, but the completion note explicitly lists only GRE/TUR/ENG. This omits Cyprus from a focus whose title requires Nicosia response.
findings.fix: Require the actual addressed parties, including CYP whenever its response is part of the proposal. Track refusal and timeout separately; neither is Cypriot consent. Do not require an irrelevant guarantor for every unrelated bilateral proposal.

findings.location: cyprus_2 title: Support the Civilian Guard
findings.finding: The National Guard is a military force. The intended distinction is loyalty to civilian constitutional authority, not that its armed members are civilian non-combatants.
findings.fix: Rename to Support Civilian Control of the Guard, or Support the Constitutional Chain of Command. Keep responsibilities and combatant status distinct.

findings.location: PASOK exile-return and Civil War reconciliation narrative
findings.finding: A universal right of return would be more inclusive than the historical 1982 settlement. The joint ministerial decision of 29 December 1982 restricted eligibility by Greek origin; the 1985 property-restoration law used a related restriction. The present focus titles can support an inclusive alternative, but historical-mode descriptions should not erase this exclusion.
findings.fix: Distinguish limited historical repatriation from an explicitly inclusive alternate policy. Describe affected people as citizens and refugees with rights, not an inherent ethnic penalty. PACE Doc. 11356, Annex I (printed page 3) and Annex II (printed page 4) attach translations; this is a written question, not an authenticated original Gazette scan.

aegean_section.title: AEGEAN · SHELF RIGHTS, SURVEYS & RESTRAINT

focuses.title: Review the Aegean Shelf Licences
focuses.conditions: A real overlapping shelf-licence/survey dispute exists; historical baseline starts with 1973 licences/1974 discoveries. An earlier equivalent is explicitly alternate history.
focuses.reward_intent: Open a separate shelf dossier, map each party's claims and record existing survey capacity.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: No new oil, sea ownership, naval superiority or hostility is granted merely by opening the dossier.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

focuses.title: Fund Hydrographic and Legal Surveys
focuses.conditions: An owned legal/survey institution has capacity; domestic survey and legal budget funded.
focuses.reward_intent: Improve the quality of domestic surveys and legal preparation; enable the strategic choice.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: Spend actual funding and staff time. Seismic evidence does not prove title or guarantee viable commercial reserves.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

focuses.title: Offer Reciprocal Survey Restraint
focuses.conditions: Submit a precise GRE-to-TUR proposal with geographic scope, monitoring and duration.
focuses.reward_intent: If both actually accept and implement, reduce the relevant Aegean escalation pressure and release some patrol burden.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: Forego the speed and potential exploration returns of unilateral survey priority; Turkish refusal remains a distinct outcome.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

focuses.title: Assert a Licensed Exploration Programme
focuses.conditions: Greece chooses a funded survey/licence policy; appropriate domestic permit and real vessel capacity exist.
focuses.reward_intent: Prioritize national geological knowledge and prospective development inside the actual researched system.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: Turkey can contest, negotiate, shadow or escalate on its own initiative. Greek licensing is not proof of uncontested rights; no automatic war or oil payout.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

focuses.title: Record the Counterpart's Actual Response
focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; an answer, explicit non-response timeout or independently observed incident is recorded.
focuses.reward_intent: Expose the actual diplomatic/legal situation and subsequent options.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: No acceptance by bypass or silence; rejection must not block unrelated Greek development.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

focuses.title: Negotiate a Berne-Style Framework
focuses.conditions: Actual willingness to negotiate is verified. Historical reference: November 1976 agreement; earlier equivalent marked alternate.
focuses.reward_intent: Request good-faith delimitation talks, reciprocal restraint and agreed procedures. Grant only implemented bilateral measures.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: No imposed median line, island cession or final maritime delimitation. Refusal/deferment gets an honest record without treaty rewards.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

focuses.title: Seek a Valid Jurisdictional Basis
focuses.conditions: Greek legal dossier funded; distinguish submitting an application from obtaining jurisdiction.
focuses.reward_intent: Invite a special agreement or establish another valid legal basis for adjudication. Greece may file unilaterally without receiving a guaranteed merits hearing.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: Historical 1976 application did not produce a merits victory; ICJ found no jurisdiction in 1978. No automatic TUR consent, judgement or sovereign/resource transfer.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

focuses.title: Fund a Durable Maritime Posture
focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite, with refusal/no-jurisdiction treated as recorded outcomes; fund actual domestic patrol, rescue and communications capacity.
focuses.reward_intent: If an agreement is implemented, support verification/deconfliction; otherwise sustain an explicitly unresolved defensive and rescue posture.
focuses.tradeoff_intent: No automatic peace or revision of claims. Maintain operating costs; no fictional free navy or deletion of Turkish agency.
focuses.note: Design suggestion only; root chooses validated MD code, funding amounts and final routing.

aegean_section.layout_note: Coordinates are suggestions at the requested 64,74 anchor. Routes 5 and 6 are complementary and must NOT be mutually exclusive. Only survey-priority choices 2/3 are exclusive. Keep root/dossier paths in a separate lower corridor; final positioning agent may shift them.
historical_baseline: Modern oil/shelf licensing dispute emerges in 1973-1974; do not project all later Aegean disputes into January 1970.

Greece filed at the ICJ on 10 August 1976. The provisional-measures request was not granted on 11 September 1976; the jurisdiction judgement of 19 December 1978 did not settle the merits or award the shelf.
UNSC Resolution 395, adopted on 25 August 1976, urged restraint and negotiation, not an imposed maritime boundary.
November 1976 Berne framework is a useful negotiating precedent. Contemporary diplomatic follow-up records continuing disagreement; no claim that all claims were solved.

Territorial sea, airspace, flight-information regions, island sovereignty and continental-shelf resource rights are different issues. Avoid importing 1990s grey-zone or casus-belli doctrines into the initial 1970 dispute.
legal_and_MP_rules: Treat Greece's and Turkey's current official legal assertions as their attributed positions. Neither becomes a neutral court judgement.

Adjudication needs a valid jurisdictional basis, potentially a special agreement or other binding consent. Filing a unilateral application is possible but is not guaranteed jurisdiction, victory or enforcement.
Each government can choose its own funded survey/posture policy. Foreign consent is required for bilateral agreements, not for acknowledging that a domestic action occurred.
No focus can declare war for a foreign human, compel another government to accept, transfer an island, allocate the entire sea or instantly add oil.
Actual resource development needs research, viable deposits, infrastructure, financing and a legally/physically implemented project. Merchant fleets are not combat navies.
Decline, delay and no-response are explicit outcomes; they never masquerade as signature or consent. Do not make unrelated diplomacy depend on successful Turkish acceptance.
